segments.sn22.138:1.2: “Yaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ; tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.138:1.4: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ; tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn22.138:1.5: Vedanā aniccā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ;
segments.sn22.138:1.9: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, aniccaṃ; tatra vo rāgo pahātabbo”ti.
